# R46 results (generated by report.py; statistics only)

Design 2024-01-01 to 2026-04-01 (821 days); holdout 2026-04-01 to 2026-10-13 (195 days, read once)

Money in USD. 'per lot' = 1 Delta contract (0.001 BTC); 'claim size' = the other AI's 1,000 contracts (1 BTC of underlying). Main fill = the option price one minute later + half spread. After tax = 31.2% of each winning trade's gross gain, no set-off. p = random-entry twins (1,000 draws, same days), q = BH over the 14-variant family.
